items.question: Through which whistleblowing programme can individuals report tax evasion or fraud to the UAE Federal Tax Authority?
items.gold: Raqeeb, the whistleblowing programme of the Federal Tax Authority.
items.fact: Tax evasion reports go through Raqeeb whistleblowing programme

items.question: How do licensed financial institutions in the UAE report suspicious money laundering or terrorism financing transactions to the UAE Financial Intelligence Unit?
items.fact: Suspicious transactions reported to FIU via goAML portal
